say:2:1711122002:1.text: What are you looking at? Haven't you ever seen a down-on-his-luck fox before? Humph!
say:2:1711122002:1.source_cn: ……看什么看？没见过落魄狐狸吗？哼！

choice_prompt:3:1711122002.text: What are you looking at? Haven't you ever seen a down-on-his-luck fox before? Humph!
choice_prompt:3:1711122002.source_cn: ……看什么看？没见过落魄狐狸吗？哼！

say:4:1711122003:1.text: That's what they say, but I'm already lucky if I can fill my stomach...
say:4:1711122003:1.source_cn: 说是这么说，可我能填饱肚子已经很不错了……

choice_prompt:6:1711122006.text: We both have four legs and a body of fur, but I, a poor fox with a profound soul, can only stay here and study whether the bread has gone bad!
choice_prompt:6:1711122006.source_cn: 同样是长了四条腿和一身毛，我这拥有深邃灵魂的可怜狐狸，却只能在这里研究面包有没有馊掉！

choice_prompt:9:1711122008.text: This world is hopeless. Everyone likes those innocent-looking fools, but ignores a deep-thinking fox like me!
choice_prompt:9:1711122008.source_cn: 这世界没救了，大家都喜欢那种眼神清澈的笨蛋，而对我这种深沉的狐狸视而不见！

say:11:1711122010:1.text: If you're looking for it, try your luck somewhere else! Don't get in my way while I'm eating my hard bread!
say:11:1711122010:1.source_cn: 你要找它，就去别的地方碰运气！别在这里妨碍我啃硬面包！

choice:9:0:1.text: Where are those idiots with clear, innocent eyes?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 那种眼神清澈的笨蛋在哪里？

choice:6:0:1.text: Similarly? Have you seen other foxes?

choice:6:1:2.text: The fox that frequents the tavern isn't you?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 在酒馆长期出没的狐狸不是你？

say:13:1711122004:1.text: It's easy for you to talk when you're not the one suffering! Do you know what outrageous discrimination I just witnessed?!
say:13:1711122004:1.source_cn: 站着说话不腰疼！你知道我刚才目睹了多么离谱的差别待遇吗？！

choice:3:1:2.text: Having food is already pretty good.

say:14:1711122005:1.text: Rude! They have no compassion whatsoever!
say:14:1711122005:1.source_cn: 粗鲁！连点同情心都没有！

choice:3:2:3.text: I want to ask about something.
